name: ot_qkh_ktree_lk_nc32c

pin_regs.reason: The K-tree RTL registers every input at the pin (kp_r 512, kv_r, gf_r 16 = the existing input stage; the new kpv_in[15:1] reach gf_r through one XOR + one OR) and every output (sc_d / sc_f / g_f) is a tile output register. A generic extra stage would add a cycle to the scheduled K path (head ages are compiled with the closed ot_qkh_ktree latency).

reset_landing.reason: The RTL owns the landing: rst_n -> rst_l0 -> rst_l1 (2 registered face stages, async assert / sync release; 2 rst_n sinks), then ot_rst_relay_bounded32 #(53) (8 root endpoints, leaves <= 32).

structural_change: KV-PARAMS4 10-20 safe32 successor of ot_qkh_ktree_lk (lkp: reset 369 / SS -88 / hops 410-418 obligations): ncr adders, bounded32 #(53) reset farm, ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat_ncr (constant SCALE, one-hot normalise from 2 kept root-y copies, kept selects, B encode copy). Same ports, pins faces, latency; outline 151.2 x 97.2 -> 172.8 x 129.6 (synth ~10.9k um2 = 74% in the old slot).
